claims.explanation: Etoposide kills cells by poisoning TOP2A/TOP2B and generating DNA double-strand breaks, so selectivity is largely determined by whether the resulting damage engages a competent apoptotic program. TP53 mutation is nearly universal in the most-killed lines and is the dominant sensitizing feature, consistent with p53-dependent apoptosis being required for efficient execution of etoposide-induced death, while intact p53 in several least-affected lines (e.g., UACC62, IGR37, LOXIMVI, OV7) is associated with relative protection. Additional sensitizers include high TOP2A/proliferation and intact BAX/BAK mitochondrial apoptosis, whereas NF-kB-driven anti-apoptotic signaling (c-IAP1/2, TRAF1/2) and calreticulin-dependent immunogenic-death pathways are protective.

features.basis: TP53-mutant lines dominate the most-killed set; p53 is required for efficient etoposide-induced apoptosis (PMID 8402885)
Etoposide is a TOP2A poison; CRISPR screen identified TOP2A as the expected resistance gene and virtual cell shows TOP2A downregulation (PMID 24336569)
BAX/BAK are the requisite mitochondrial gateway for etoposide-induced apoptosis (PMID 11326099)
BAX/BAK double deficiency confers complete resistance to etoposide (PMID 11326099)
CRISPR screen identified CDK6 loss as conferring etoposide resistance, so high CDK6 may be protective (PMID 24336569)
NF-kB activation induces c-IAP1/2 and TRAF1/2 that suppress etoposide-induced apoptosis (PMID 9733516)
c-IAP1 is sufficient to suppress etoposide-induced apoptosis downstream of NF-kB (PMID 9733516)
c-IAP2 is sufficient to suppress etoposide-induced apoptosis (PMID 9733516)
Calreticulin exposure restores immunogenicity of etoposide-induced cell death and enhances antitumor effects (PMID 17187072)
PTEN-mutant lines (UACC62, ZR751, FTC133, OV7) are enriched among least-affected lines, suggesting intact PTEN/AKT-apoptosis signaling modulates response
BRAF-mutant melanomas (UACC62, IGR37, LOXIMVI, K029AX) are overrepresented among least-affected lines
KRAS-mutant lines (T3M4, SNU410, GSU, OV7, KPNSI9S) are enriched among least-affected lines
